name: FormSection
purpose: Group related labeled form controls in a native fieldset with an associated description and responsive field layout.
description: A native fieldset and legend with associated description and a shared responsive ContentGrid. It does not render a form, assign names to fields, validate data or submit values. Native disabled inheritance covers DOM descendants; portaled or custom controls still require their explicit disabled props. Keep legends noninteractive.

props.name: actions
props.description: Host-owned controls after the fields, inside the native disabled boundary.

props.name: maxColumns
props.description: Maximum field columns; the shared grid collapses with available container width.

guidance.overview: Group related labeled form controls in a native fieldset with an associated description and responsive field layout.
usage: Group related fields under a short noninteractive legend. Each field still needs its own label.
Wrap in a host form when submission is intended; action buttons keep explicit button/submit types.
Use maxColumns as a responsive cap and reuse the shared minItemWidth choices.
accessibility: The native fieldset uses its legend as its group name and associates the optional description.
Native disabled inheritance excludes first-legend descendants and portaled/custom controls. Set explicit disabled props on those controls.
intent: Transparent grouping, with no card surface, validation state or save behavior added.
context: Use within a settings page or editor, with the host owning drafts, validation, reset and persistence.
